acquisition_method.evidence: All label-free SGBS adipocyte samples were analyzed in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) on a setup consisting of an Ultimate 3000 RS nano ultraperformance liquid chromatography system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to a Q Exactive HF Hybrid Quadrupole Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a TriVersa NanoMate system (Advion).
All murine tissue and human SVF samples were analyzed in data-independent acquisition (DIA) on the same instrumental setup.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: 1 mg of protein from SGBS cell lysates and 0.48 mg of protein from tissue lysates were reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (DTT; GE Healthcare) for 1 h and alkylated with 10 mM iodacetamid (IAA; Merck, Germany) for 30 min before the urea concentration was diluted to <2 M with 20 mM HEPES pH 8.0.
In brief, proteins were reduced using 20 mM TCEP at 55 °C for 1 h, alkylated with 37.5 mM IAA at RT for 30 min, and cleaved into tryptic peptides at 37 °C overnight.
